Definition: from G3735; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of G5561) the Highlands (of Judæa):--hill country.
BiblicalUsage: The hill country is where Mary went in haste to see Elisabeth after the angel's visit, and where fear came on all that dwelt round about when John was born and named.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced the hill country matters because God met ordinary people there: Mary hurried to Elisabeth, and the whole region talked about what God was doing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
